annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She's probably telling herself she caused all of it.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: walk her through the timing, minute by minute, so she can see
annotations.pda_responsibility: the choice at the lever was mine

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: like he thought he owed me something
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd want to tell him plainly there's no debt.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want him carrying that.
annotations.pda_responsibility: He was working, and I made a call.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'll want to hear it from the person who pulled the lever
annotations.ce_supportive_use: So I'd offer to sit with them
annotations.pda_repair_intention: answer whatever they ask without dressing it up

annotations.ce_supportive_use: show him how I read the tracks in those few seconds
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: He's worked with me for years.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: may believe I was careless, that I didn't look properly
annotations.ce_supportive_use: give them the full account myself, every detail
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd ask to give them the full account myself

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect is angry with me, like I had no business choosing
annotations.ce_supportive_use: being heard would matter more to him than any explanation

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The investigators will want a tidy justification
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since their job depends on getting the sequence right
annotations.ce_supportive_use: give them every fact I have, clearly and slowly

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably expecting the worst, maybe thinking I was hurt
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'll call and tell her I'm all right

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the station master feels this is on him
annotations.ce_supportive_use: It might ease his mind a bit
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: so the next person at that lever has more time than I did

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They probably expect me to avoid them now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: let them see I'm not hiding from what happened
